records.title: Instagram photo by Tate • May 15, 2016 at 11:29am UTC
records.description: Happy Birthday Jasper Johns born #onthisday 1930  In the 1950s Johns began using flags targets and numbers as the basis of his #paintings. These were ordinary familiar things but also had an iconic emblematic quality. '0 through 9' is one of a series that he undertook in the summer of 1960 using the superimposed numbers 0 to 9. Johns let the process of painting the number sequence dictate the structure of the painting. This allowed him to concentrate on the qualities of the paint itself exploring colour and thickness. The result is a highly #abstract structure but one rooted firmly in the real world. by tate

records.description: I met Zaha Hadid once. By coincidence we were both staying at the same hotel in Seoul Korea. The elevator opened up in front of me and there she was standing in it. I got in and worked up the courage to speak to her although she never made eye contact. Finally I said "Ms. Hadid I love your work." Then the elevator doors opened to the lobby and she swept out without looking in my direction and gave a quick reply: "Many do". RIP #zahahadid by modarchitecture
